summary: The meeting covered several key areas, including the 2.4 release, payment migration, support backlog, accessibility audit, office move, intern hiring, partner API limits, and data retention policy. Regarding the 2.4 release, it was decided to postpone shipping until the calendar crash is fixed and retested, with the fix due by Wednesday and regression testing scheduled for Thursday. For payments, the group agreed to stay with the current provider and migrate in two phases: card payments in June and saved methods in August. The support backlog issue was addressed by agreeing to hire a temporary person for six weeks to help clear the tickets. The accessibility audit was tentatively scheduled for the first week of June, pending budget confirmation. The group also decided to offer the internship to the second candidate, who is to receive the offer on Monday. Regarding the partner API, the limit for the two problematic partners will be raised to 300 requests per minute, contingent on new per-key monitoring being in place. Finally, the data retention policy was adopted to keep booking logs for eighteen months, and the default notification setting was lowered to one reminder. Several follow-up tasks were assigned to address remaining open items.
